records.claim: Italy's 2026 non-seasonal subordinate-work route operates within the 2026-2028 Flussi programming and has a defined quota of 76,200 non-seasonal subordinate entries. Applications remain subject to the applicable quota and route conditions.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Government — Portale Integrazione Migranti / Ministry of Interior and partner ministries
records.methodology: Exact annual route scope; does not generalize to all Italian work authorization routes.

records.claim: The 2026 Flussi government material reviewed establishes the annual quota and employer-side application framework but does not establish a single applicant proof-of-funds amount that can safely be treated as the route's universal financial requirement. This remains an explicit evidence gap pending the applicable nulla-osta and applicant documentation rules.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Government — Portale Integrazione Migranti / Ministry of Interior and partner ministries
records.methodology: Explicit research-gap record. No financial requirement is invented from the quota figures.

records.claim: For the 2026 non-seasonal subordinate route, applications are pre-compiled through the ALI Services Portal and submitted from the applicable click-day date, with applications accepted through 31 December 2026 subject to quota availability. Employer-side nulla-osta and applicant-side visa documentation remain distinct steps requiring separate evidence validation.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Government — Portale Integrazione Migranti / Ministry of Interior and partner ministries
records.methodology: Exact annual process evidence; click-day dates are treated as 2026 operational facts rather than timeless visa rules.
